page0.text:
I'm still not over what happened to Mitsuzuri, leading me to the archery range.
It's set off from the other school buildings and looks empty.
Club activities are over, so I don't think I'll find anybody here.

page1.text:
"...I guess I'll go home."
I turn around and head to the gate.
Beyond that, on the way to the exit...
...Shinji Matou stands there, as if to block my way.

page2.text:
"Hey, you're going home this late? Weren't all students supposed to go home immediately what with the danger and all?"
...
I don't have the confidence to stay calm facing Shinji here.
So I try to ignore him and walk past.

page3.text:
"Aww, man. So tired that you can't even greet your friend, huh?
Damn, must be draining to spend so much time destroying sigils."
He sounds like he's grinning.
"...!"
Hearing that, I immediately jump back and brace myself.

page4.text:
"Destroying sigils... For you to say that, then..."
I keep myself on alert and glare at Shinji.

page5.text:
"Yeah, that's right. The Bounded Field that you so thoroughly eliminated was the security measure I set up.
If it's destroyed like that, I'll be so scared that I won't be able to come to school anymore."

page6.text:
...
...I see.
So this is how naïve I am.
When I saw him in the woods, I knew he was a Master but didn't try to confirm it because I wasn't prepared for the truth.

page7.text:
"Hold on. Don't be on guard like that, Emiya. Since that annoying Tohsaka is gone, let's talk things over like men. You know I deplore fighting."
"Talk things over...? You don't want to fight?"

page8.text:
"Of course not.
I'm guessing you were forced to be this Master thing too, right?
I'm in the same boat. I was forced to be a Master even though I'm not a mage, nor do I really want to fight."

page9.text: "So at the moment, I'm trying to find a way to get through this without fighting anybody. I have no intention of starting something with you."

page10.text: "...I see. Then what's up with that Bounded Field? You're saying you don't want to fight even though you have that thing set up?"

page11.text:
"Dumbass, that's for my protection. Tohsaka's at this school, and she's a mage through and through.
She won't hesitate to fight. So as a Master that's not a mage, I have to set up protection for myself.
That's all that that Bounded Field was. I won't activate it as long as I don't get attacked.

page12.text:
...
...His story makes sense.
I still don't know the details behind whether Shinji really is a Master or not, or how he got to this point.
But for now, I'll buy it.
If Shinji says so, I should give him the benefit of the doubt.
But, before that...

page13.text:
"Shinji. Are you the one who attacked the female student yesterday?"
I need to solve this problem.

page14.text:
"...Oh, yesterday? I couldn't help it.
My Servant is an unmanageable woman, and she attacks people if I let her be.
I'm just a normal person who was chosen to be a Master. I'm not like Tohsaka where it's my main job, so it's hard for me to get her to listen to my orders."

page15.text: "...Then what happened yesterday was just an accident, right? Your Servant did it herself?"

page16.text: "Yeah, I'll be careful from now on. I don't want to cause any incidents in my own neighborhood either. I'll make sure the only thing she does is protect me."

page18.text:
"Yeah. Why would I lie? I could've hidden it, but I told you about it.
You were getting suspicious of me, right? I'll have to defend myself if you come at me, so I came out before that could happen.
I don't want to fight anybody."

page19.text:
...I can't take what he says at full value.
But, if he really does want to avoid fighting... Everything would work out.

page20.text: "Okay, I'll believe you. If you're not going to do anything, I won't do anything to you either. That work for you?"

page21.text:
"Good, you're being reasonable for once.
But not good enough. Can't you tell why I came here to talk?"

page22.text:
Shinji holds out his hand, as if he wants to shake hands.
So that means...

page23.text:
"Do you want to cooperate with me, Emiya? You probably didn't know, but the Matous are a family of mages.
...Well, it ended with my father's generation, but we still have the knowledge. How does it sound? I'll be helpful to an inexperienced Master like you, right?"

page24.text:
...
The Matou line is a family of mages...?
Tohsaka didn't say such a thing.
No, she must've excluded him as an outsider if the blood died out just as Shinji said.

page25.text: "What do you think? If you cooperate with me, we can survive the Holy Grail War without having to rely on Tohsaka. I don't think this is anything you even have to think about."

page26.text:
...
He holds out his hand.
...His proposal isn't wrong.
It makes sense, and it's an option.
However...

page27.text: "Shinji. Does Sakura know that you're a Master?"

page28.text:
"Huh? You really are an amateur, Emiya.
A family of mages like mine only teaches its secrets to the eldest son. The other kids are no more than spares.
It's a waste of time to teach magecraft to spares like that.
...Hell if I would teach a simpleton like her the ways of a mage.
I'm the only one who inherited the Matou's secrets."

page29.text:
...
I see.
That's really good.
Sakura isn't someone who should be involved in all this.
I need her to be smiling happily in life.

page30.text: "...Shinji. If you promise not to do anything, then I won't do anything to you either. There isn't a problem with it like that, right?"

page32.text:
"There's no need to, right? If we both aren't going to fight each other, there's no need to cooperate.
If you only want to protect yourself, then you should have the church take care of you until the Holy Grail War is over. You know that, right?"

page33.text: "...Oh. What is this, Emiya? Are you actually trying to win this battle to the death?"

page34.text:
...
...I don't intend to die nor do I want to murder anyone.
But I'll fight anyone who attacks me, and I can't just ignore those who will try to bring disaster to our town.
And...

page35.text:
"...I don't plan on killing anyone. But I have to see this Holy Grail thing for myself. In order to do that, I have to survive until the end, right?"
I turn away from Shinji.

page36.text:
"Is that so? So you're just going to fight, huh?
Well, it has nothing to do with me, but then you won't involve Sakura in this, right, Emiya?"

page37.text: "...Obviously not. You're going to hide this from her too, right?"

page38.text:
"Of course. But as her older brother, I can't let my little sister stay at the place of someone who's going to be involved in battles to the death.
If you're going to fight, I won't let Sakura go out until the Holy Grail War is over. You understand, Emiya?"

page39.text:
...
...He does have a point.
As long as I'm fighting alongside Saber, the Emiya household is also dangerous.

page40.text: "All right, I'll tell Sakura. That's fine, right, Shinji?"

page41.text:
"Okay. So nice of you to look out for your juniors.
To be honest, I was afraid that you were going to hold her hostage. Well, this solves my most urgent worry."

page42.text:
"...So we're done talking here. I'm going home then."
"Yeah, go ahead. But you know right, Emiya? What we discussed here stays between us. I told you my secret since you're my friend. If you tell others, I can't anticipate what I might end up doing either."

page43.text: That must mean that he'll activate the Bounded Field if I tell Tohsaka about him.

page44.text:
"...Yeah, I won't tell anyone. But it's a different story if Tohsaka finds you herself. I'm going to help Tohsaka as much as I can. I won't stop her from fighting you if she finds out your identity.
...So if you don't want to be found, you should keep your head down."
